question.text: Consider a single chart-eligible streams unit sampled uniformly from the published top ten for Spotify chart-eligible streams in DE during 2026-11-13 through 2026-11-19. Which title does that unit belong to? Predict the fraction of actual chart-eligible streams units for each option. These are volume shares, not respondents choosing their favourite or most-watched title. Repeat plays/counting and the publisher definition apply; unlisted titles form the residual.
options: HUGEL - Movin' To The Sun (w/ Imael Angel, Ultra Naté)
All other titles in the published top ten
